oneOf.description: Sew's own model: roles, overwrites and membership are edited in Sew (the default).
The governing App decides membership, private channels and levels (K2's sync).

The server-governed Space (named `K5 Space`), one per K2 install, owned by `k2:server`:
K2's daemon decides its structure over mgmt; no App session ever reaches it.

description:
Body of `POST /mgmt/v1/spaces/{space_id}/settings`. An absent field keeps its
value.

app_id.description: The Space's App; absent for an unbound Space.

governance.description:
`app` hands the Space's structure to its governing App (`409 conflict`
`no_governing_app` without one) and creates the managed Moderator and Admin roles;
`sew` hands it back (the managed roles become ordinary roles). Never
to or from `server` (`409 conflict` `server_governance_fixed`).

title: MgmtSpaceSettingsRequest
